sections.h2: A ₹150 crore grant left ₹834 crore of the ₹984 crore Panipat plant to the applicant

chart.title: A grant capped at ₹150 crore left most of the build cost uncovered
chart.source: Petroleum ministry figures as reported; see Sources section.

sections.means: Only applicants with large balance sheets could try, and in practice four state-owned oil companies were the only ones who did.
sections.todo: Before offering another capped grant, check that the likely applicants can fund the remaining cost.

sections.means: The post links the shortfall to fragmented, capped per-stage grants that make a small pool of applicants clear several hurdles at once.
sections.todo: Track whether GOBARdhan's ten-year fixed price lifts uptake before adding more per-stage grants.
